plugins.description: One number per provider in the sidebar footer: how much of its capacity is used, and when it frees up.
plugins.overview:
See how much of each provider's capacity is in use, and when it frees up,
without opening anything.

## One number per provider

Pool Usage puts each connected provider's logo at the right end of the sidebar
footer with the share of its capacity in use right now: Claude and Codex,
every account in Account Pooler if you use it, and other providers that report
usage to BB, such as Cursor. Accounts weigh by the vendors' stated plan
multipliers, so a Max 20x seat counts twenty times a Pro seat. Codex Business
Pro Lite and Pro Lite each count as 5x Plus. The number turns red at 80%, or at
the percentage you pick in the plugin's only setting, **Red at, %**.

## When it frees up

Click a number for the provider's card, styled like the footer's `…` menu: the
total, the number of accounts when there are several, and up to four lines
showing when the total drops next and what it drops to.

## Resets

When Account Pooler's Claude or Codex accounts hold resets, which clear an
account's usage limits early, the card ends with a line such as
"Reset to 27% (3 available)": the total right after the reset that frees the
most capacity over the next week. Clicking it asks first, in BB's own dialog,
naming the account, when the reset expires, and the total before and after.
Only **Use reset** spends it.

## What it reads

The numbers refresh every 30 seconds. Pool Usage reads Account Pooler's
redacted account status and BB's provider usage readings. For resets, its
server uses the access tokens Account Pooler stores: it asks Anthropic and
OpenAI for them every 10 minutes and spends one only when you confirm it.
Tokens never reach the frontend, and the plugin never refreshes one.

plugins.description: Bookmark any chat message and jump back to it from a Bookmarks tab in the thread's right panel.
plugins.overview:
Save the answers worth coming back to, and get back to them in one click.

## Bookmark from the message

Every user and assistant message gets a **Bookmark** button in its action bar.
Click it and the message is saved; the button stays filled on that message, the
way a liked message looks, and clicking it again removes the bookmark with an
Undo. Select part of an assistant answer and choose **Bookmark** from the
selection menu to save just that passage as the bookmark's quote.

## A Bookmarks tab on the right

Open **Bookmarks** from the thread header, the side panel's new-tab actions, or
the quick palette (`Bookmarks: Show saved messages`). The tab lists every
bookmark, newest first, with its thread and when you saved it. Search matches
the saved text and thread titles in any case, and **This thread** narrows the
list to the open thread in timeline order.

Click a bookmark to jump straight to its message: bb opens the thread, scrolls
the timeline to the message, and flashes it, however far back it is. When the
message lives in another thread, the Bookmarks tab opens beside it so you can
keep browsing. Hover a bookmark to copy its full text or remove it.

## Local

Bookmarks live in the plugin's own SQLite database on your bb server. Each one
keeps a copy of the message text, so a bookmark stays readable after its thread
is deleted. Nothing is sent to an agent or an external service.

plugins.description: Superhuman-style speed for BB: keyboard shortcuts, universal search, snoozed threads, a compact icon sidebar, a mobile layout with image zoom, terminal paste, and one-click server changes.
plugins.overview:
Superhuman-style features for BB:

- **Shortcuts.** Shortcut hints on a held modifier; **/** searches, **H** snoozes,
  **E** archives, and numbers open a new thread's menus, in any keyboard layout.
- **Universal Search.** Find commands, threads, and snoozed threads using both
  the typed query and its English/Russian keyboard equivalent. On by default;
  built-in command and thread search support requires BB 0.44.0.
- **Snooze.** Hide a thread until a set time or until its agent needs you; use
  the moon in its header or before Archive in the sidebar row.
- **Archive Button.** Archive a thread from its header, next to Snooze.
- **Thread ETA.** The time left on an agent's background process counts down
  at the end of its sidebar row until it runs out or the agent clears it.
- **Code Copy.** Click or tap a code block or inline command in an agent's
  reply to copy it. Always on; text selection still works.
- **Preload Threads.** Load the tail of recent and newly completed threads in
  the background. On by default; uses BB 0.44.0's cache and pauses when hidden.
- **Dia Sidebar.** The sidebar's navigation as a compact grid of icons.
- **Terminal Paste.** A Paste button for the terminal on phones and tablets.
- **Server Switcher.** A **Change Server** button in the sidebar footer.
- **Mobile Layout.** Bottom bars, gestures, and haptics on phones, with a fixed
  interface scale and pinch-to-zoom images. Thread titles stay hidden on phones.
- **UI Polish.** Icons in one tone, even menu rows, and a thread bar without
  the git action or external editor picker.

Settings include four main switches: **Shortcuts**, **Universal Search**,
**Mobile layout**, and **Archive button**. **Experimental** contains
**Thread ETA** and **Preload threads**. All six are on by default.

## More San Francisco Plugins

Superhuman is one of the San Francisco Plugins, a family of BB plugins. The
others:

- **Bookmarks**: save any chat message and jump back to it from the thread's
  right panel.
- **Canvas**: images, text, and drawing in each thread, with screenshots your
  agent can read.
- **San Francisco**: a quiet macOS-style theme after the Aside browser, with
  your pick of the eight macOS accent colors.
- **Pool Usage**: how much of each provider's capacity is in use and when it
  frees up, in the sidebar footer.

See all of them, with install steps, at
[github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins](https://github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins).

plugins.description: A quiet macOS-style theme after the Aside browser, with your pick of the eight macOS accent colors.
plugins.overview:
Make BB look like a calm, native Mac app, in the quiet style of the Aside
browser.

## A quiet window

The content sits on the gray window frame as one white card with soft corners.
Text uses the system font at 14 px, SF Pro on a Mac. Hierarchy comes from
shades of gray rather than lines: primary text is near black, and secondary
text a softer gray. Icons use a thinner stroke. Only the composer and what
floats above the page, such as menus, popovers, dialogs, toasts and the
command palette, cast a soft shadow. Dark mode follows the same rules, with a
near-black frame, a slightly lighter card and near-white text.

Text is at least as easy to read as in BB's default palette. Dark mode's card
is lighter than BB's, so its gray text, accent text and BB's terminal, diff,
status and code colors are brighter to match.

## Familiar places

In the sidebar, rows are a soft black and the open thread is a white pill.
When Search threads is visible in the navigation, it becomes a search field.
On a desktop the sidebar loses its row of back and forward buttons, and its
toggle moves into the thread's header, before the title. Thread and panel
headers lose their dividers. The composer gets larger corners, a soft shadow
and one round send button with an up arrow; Stop is the same circle with a
square. Above the composer, background work becomes one outlined card, and
queued messages a sheet tucked behind the composer. Right-panel tabs become
quiet pills, and an empty new tab centers its hint above outlined buttons.

## Settings like a document

Settings pages show a Settings › Page breadcrumb and a large page title.
Section headings are small caps, and rows sit in cards split by full-width
lines. Selects shrink to their text and use a double chevron. Buttons, inputs
and badges are lighter, and menus and popovers are compact.

## One accent color

Pick one of the eight macOS accent colors: Blue, Purple, Pink, Red, Orange,
Yellow, Green or Graphite. It underlines links and colors file names, focus
rings, text selection, switches and checkboxes; everything else stays
neutral. Provider marks keep their shapes but take the surrounding text color.

## Turn it on

Choose San Francisco under Settings → Appearance → Palette, then click an
accent swatch under Settings → San Francisco. BB applies the palette before
the first paint and a non-Blue accent a moment later, once plugins load. Light
and dark follow BB's Theme setting. Choose Default to return to BB's look. No
external account or service is required.

## More San Francisco Plugins

San Francisco is one of the San Francisco Plugins, a family of BB plugins. The
others:

- **Superhuman**: Superhuman-style speed for BB, with shortcut hints, snooze,
  a compact grid of navigation icons, and a phone layout.
- **Bookmarks**: save any chat message and jump back to it from the thread's
  right panel.
- **Canvas**: images, text, and drawing in each thread, with screenshots your
  agent can read.
- **Pool Usage**: how much of each provider's capacity is in use and when it
  frees up, in the sidebar footer.

See all of them, with install steps, at
[github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins](https://github.com/rebryk/bb-plugins).

plugins.description: A canvas in each thread for images, text, and drawing, with screenshots your agent can read.
plugins.overview:
Collect screenshots, write notes, and sketch feedback in each thread's Canvas.

## Images, notes, and drawing

Open **Canvas** in the thread's right panel. Paste a screenshot with **⌘V** /
**Ctrl+V**, drop an image, or choose **Add image**. Select, move, and resize
images; add text or yellow sticky notes; draw freehand or drag out an arrow.
Text grows as you type, with new lines only on **Enter**. Square sticky notes
wrap and fit their text automatically; resizing a note scales the text with it.
Double-click text or a note to edit within its selection frame. Hold **Shift**
for horizontal or vertical lines and arrows. Clicks and tiny movements do not
leave stray dots.
Colors and three visual size presets sit in the toolbar for one-click
selection. Drag annotations with a mouse in any tool; hold **Alt** / **Option**
to draw or write over them. Images move and
resize with **Select**, leaving the other tools free to annotate them.
Double-click an image with **Select** to crop it. Drag the edges or move the
frame, then click outside to save and deselect. **Escape** cancels; expand the
crop edges to reveal the original image again.
Copy selected elements with **⌘C** / **Ctrl+C**, cut with **⌘X** / **Ctrl+X**,
and paste with **⌘V** / **Ctrl+V**, within the same canvas or into another
thread. Copies preserve styles and layout; Undo removes a pasted group in one
step. Zoom and fit keep navigation simple.

## Capture a browser block

Desktop BB's built-in browser has a **Canvas** toolbar button. Hover to
highlight a block and click to capture its visible portion directly into the
thread's canvas. **↑** selects its parent; **Escape** cancels. Embedded frames
are captured as whole blocks. In web BB, paste or upload a screenshot instead.

## Show your agent

Agents can read saved element positions and text with **canvas_read**, or see
the entire board with **canvas_screenshot**, even when the panel is closed.
You can export the same view as a PNG. Newly installed tools are available on
the next agent session start.

## Saved per thread

The board saves locally on the BB server as JSON with separate images. Each
thread keeps its own canvas across panel closures and restarts. Failed saves
show **Retry** and retain a recovery draft across reloads in the current browser
tab when storage is available. Drafts stay isolated between tabs.
Deleting a thread removes its canvas. The controls follow your BB theme,
including San Francisco's accent colors.

- **San Francisco**: a quiet macOS-style theme after the Aside browser, with

- **Pool Usage**: how much of each provider's capacity is in use and when it

See all of them, with install steps, at
